validation.adapter_test_scope: The recorded 283 source tests and 111 independent focused checks belong to the unchanged original adapter qualification; they were not rerun as new adapter suites for this helper-only correction.
validation.post_native_package_binding_check: PASS: 69 source files, 42 installed package files, 6 helpers, 3 inputs and exact wheel binding; no native launch from the check.

cleanup.plugin_observed_status: zombie; exited/inactive, not absent or reaped

limits.unsupported: Saved channels, paths, floating selections, nonempty drawable filters, indexed/HDR source formats.

limits.retention_claim: The original input XCF is byte-identical and full master RGBA is retained. Before/after native checkpoint XCF byte identity is not claimed. PNG equality claims use decoded RGBA except where a specific file hash is provided.
limits.filesystem_scope: Trusted isolated host and caller-controlled allowed directories; no hostile same-user or cross-user Windows ACL guarantee. A cleanup error after publication is not a rollback or retry-safe outcome.
limits.native_coverage: Three successful preview exports, one preview reopen/readback, and one unsupported-extension rejection. Other failure/collision paths have host-free coverage only. No native Windows, complete suite, every GIMP property or full showcase acceptance claim.
limits.binary_privacy_scope: This selected receipt contains no raw metadata, raw trace, private filesystem location, credentials, host identifier, process identifier or job identifier. It includes only the specifically reported run-local image IDs. It does not grant publication clearance to arbitrary raw logs or binary metadata.
limits.active_image_scope: Actual source-matching IDs are checked before and after all three successful previews. The unsupported-extension rejection retains source inspection, image inventory and no-output checks without a separate active-image sample.
limits.cleanup_correction_scope: The entered guarded cleanup tail releases process-local lifecycle state despite final metrics or receipt failures. Startup before that protected block and pathological error-formatting failures are outside this narrow guarantee; no force-kill or transactional host rollback is introduced.

active_image_verification.assertion: Explicit completed native result.context.image.image_id must be a positive built-in integer, excluding booleans, and must equal the intended source before and after each successful preview.
active_image_verification.identifiers_scope: Run-local native image IDs requested for verification; they are not process, account, host or job identifiers.

historical_correction.explanation: The original generic image_id lookup did not descend into the nested image object. Its six lookups returned None, so their equality was not valid active-image assertion evidence. Independent read-only analysis of the intact original completed responses found actual pairs 1 to 1, 8 to 8 and 8 to 8. The fresh native02 run executes the corrected strict assertions and supplies the current qualification; native01 remains historical.
historical_correction.separate_cleanup_correction: The verification helper now executes token removal, signal-handler restoration and lane-lock release through the guarded cleanup finalizer before attempting its cleanup receipt. Host-free metric, serialization and receipt-failure checks pass; such errors block cleanup success. The fresh native run follows normal owned shutdown without those injected faults.

accepted_media_retention.scope: Container bytes differ only in the ancillary PNG timestamp chunk and its checksum. All native02 preview pixels, native reopened pixels, full master before/after pixels and both alpha fixtures also equal their native01 counterparts.
